title: Remove the scheduling assumption from the latch panic-retry test
outcome: Remove the scheduling assumption from the latch panic-retry test
acceptance: build_identity::tests::a_bounded_call_never_reads_itself_after_its_reading_panicked no longer asserts the reading count right after its 300 ms held retry, which assumed the new reader thread was scheduled within 300 ms; the count is asserted only after release and a successful latch, or reader entry is synchronized without lengthening the deadline; the test passes, and no deadline or behaviour assertion is loosened

completion.summary:
The latch panic-retry test no longer assumes the reader thread spawned by its 300 ms bounded call was scheduled within 300 ms. After that call, a bounded 30 s yield loop waits for the reader to begin, then asserts READINGS == 2; every deadline and behaviour assertion is unchanged.
